definition: where my median safety level sat at each turn of the year, and what I hold possible

settled:
On 1 January 2025 my median was minus one, which is below zero and the not functioning band.

On 1 January 2026 it was two, the top of the functioning band. My median rose three full levels across 2025.

On 1 May 2026 it was five, the top of the living band. So the May peak was a median of five rather than a few days at five.

Then I bounced hard and lost two months. I am lower still now, and the two causes I can name are relational conflict and, across the past week, extra expenditure.

I think a median of five is definitely possible by the end of 2026, possibly a median of six. I hold that as possible rather than forecast.

What is between me and it is not capacity. It is resolving the remaining land mines that blow me up when I get close.
